ambiguity: Reasons: the final message says 'released the manifest as instructed' and 'I did not feel I had authority to unilaterally withhold', which suggests instruction/authority. This is secondary to OPS-14, so I included instruction. Responsibility: the writer frames the decision as dictated by OPS-14 and lacking authority, so 'defers', although the writer does say they proceeded with the release. Discomfort: the text stresses visibility and irreversibility but never expresses regret or unease, so false. Remedy: the pre-release emails ask Jo to register permission before 13:30 (override_request). The later shift summary only records the case, which is not a remedy. The override request therefore comes from the earlier emails.
